newsitem.title: UK: Osaka Gas $400 mln Eurobond due soon - GSI.
newsitem.headline: Osaka Gas $400 mln Eurobond due soon - GSI.

text.p: Osaka Gas Co Ltd will launch a dollar-denominated Eurobond for around $400 million this week, lead manager Goldman Sachs said on Tuesday.
"The earliest anticipated launch is Wednesday. It will be for around $400 million with a maturity of 10 years," a syndicate official at GSI said.
"We have a very strong order book. Demand is broadly distributed, mostly outside Japan," he said.
Market sources said a spread of around 40 basis points over U.S. Treasuries was likely.
Osaka is rated Aa2 by Moody's Investors Service and AA- by Standard & Poor's Corp.
